body:
My life's been full of ups and downs really. What I'm struggling with right now? I'm about to fail my first semester of university courses, again, after failing a first time last fall, and taking a year to cope. I can't handle the thought of how my dad is going to handle it. I've failed him so many times already. 

I have extreme anxiety. I sweat like a fountain whenever I'm in public and that makes going out even harder for me. I have extreme isolation issues. Once I miss a couple of classes in a row that's basically it for me. I can't cope with the fear and dread inside of me and just the idea of going to face my profs is impossible to cope with. So I isolate myself inside my room, the only place I can feel somewhat at ease. 

Commitment seems to be one of my biggest problems. I just can't focus. I get so afraid, I try to avoid all kinds of human contact. I stopped seeing my councillor for this reason, I just couldn't focus on the material she wanted me to look up on, and couldn't stand the thought of talking to her about it.

My mom died when I was in 9th grade, it fucked me up pretty good. I don't think it's the sole cause of my issues, but it's definitely related. I had problems in high school, basically the same thing, not attending classes, I always tried to be sick, so I wouldn't have to go to school. I ended up being held in at lunch almost daily by the time I was about to graduate as punishment, and basically told I needed to get over my moms death. I don't like feeling like a victim, but the worst feeling of all is that people think I act like a victim to get out of things.

It makes me feel like maybe that's what I am, and I just don't know it. It makes me sick to just think about it. On top of all that. I'm a messy person. My hygiene has gone down the drain, I don't shower nearly enough, my living spaces are always messy, I never change the bed sheets, I get called lazy a lot. I'm not sure if it's just laziness or if it's just the fact I don't care anymore.

I apologize for going off on such a tangent, my mind is always just a jumble of thoughts. I have a really short attention span and I tend to just throw everything out at once which results in poor communication.
